appendix.authoring_note: Reduced dictionary. The per-feature classification, response direction and stability entries are derived from the market-correction attribution, which this run does not produce.
appendix.market_offset_note: This model has no market offset. Every column below entered the booster as an ordinary feature, including 'Implied_Prob', and no base margin was supplied.

training_window.detail: a separate fit per evaluation year, each on 2010 through the year before it -- 11 fits in all
training_window.sentence: The 2016 evaluation model was trained on the initial 2010-2015 set. Each later evaluation adds the preceding complete season, so the training window expands by one year; the 2026 model uses 2010-2025. Every evaluation year is fitted separately -- 11 fits in all -- and no evaluation year's outcomes appear in its own fit.
training_window.summary: initial 2010-2015, expanding by one season per evaluation year

betting.reason: No bet ledger has been settled for this model. It is the unanchored baseline the offset architecture exists to improve on, and it has not passed a promotion gate; settling it would produce a bankroll path that reads as a recommendation for a model nobody proposes to stake.

effects.reason: There is no market correction belonging to this model to attribute. This model learns a utility directly from the feature matrix, in which the market's implied probability is one ordinary column rather than a base margin, so a per-feature attribution here would decompose the utility -- a different quantity from the market correction the attribution artifact declares, and not comparable with the effects reported for the market-anchored models. What this model's features do to its probabilities is therefore not published rather than published under a name that would mislead.

ensemble.reason: There is no ensemble to be stable: this run fitted a single seed, so there is no member disagreement to measure. The headline probability is that one fit's own output, which the identity card states.

uncertainty.reason: There is no settled outcome to put an interval on. Both intervals this report can show resample a settlement rather than a prediction -- race days drawn with replacement, and winners drawn from the model's own probabilities and settled at Win Odds -- and no bet ledger has been settled for this model, for the reason the betting section gives.
